text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to meet with Mayano Top
Gun. As
I reach the classroom...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmph. I know better than you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Where'd you come from,
Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, "what's up?" yourself! What are
you
doing, getting popular out of
nowhere?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Just a second ago, I was talking about
how you're
really good at explaining
things 'cause you're an
adult.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
And then my classmates started saying
you're
sooo wonderful because you
organize all my
equipment so nicely.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I think you're wonderful all the time!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Whether we're racing or just hanging
out, I'm
always having fun when I'm with
you!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: I'm happy you feel that way.

text_block_list.text:
How come everyone else knows cool
things about
you that I don't know? I
don't like that—not one
bit!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I told them something new! About this
and that...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heehee! ☆ They were all so
shocked—like, "No
way!"
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: Wh-what exactly did you tell them?!

text_block_list.text:
It's a secret. ♪ That's your punishment
for getting
popular!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I was worried that she wasn't satisfied
with my
instruction, so I'm glad that's not
the case. I'm
definitely curious about
what she said though...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
